name: fix-02
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:

INPUT ROLES: image 1 is the APPROVED SOFT 3D STYLE ONLY. Image 2 is an ORIGINAL ICON GEOMETRY GUIDE in the SAME row-major cells, with small identification labels underneath. Preserve its subject shapes/count/state, but transform flat shapes into the approved dimensional soft 3D material style. Do NOT copy guide labels, numbers, flat vector lines or cream background. Transparent output remains mandatory. The detailed corrections below take precedence over any ambiguous guide simplifications.
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A red rounded wooden daruma head with a cream face above three thick wooden discs in red, muted teal and ochre, the lowest disc offset to the right. A small natural-wood mallet stands alongside; keep the separate stacked pieces visible. CRITICAL: This is the WOODEN STACKING DISC GAME, not the eye-painting ritual. The red head has TWO identical BLACK eyes and a plain cream face, sits on three separate red/teal/ochre discs; lowest disc offset. Match geometry reference 1. No blank white eye.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: Seven flat painted wooden tangram pieces fitted into one square: five triangles of three sizes, one square and one parallelogram. Use coral, ochre, teal, blue, lavender, pale blue and dusty rose; keep the seven seams clear and add no markings. CRITICAL: Match geometry reference 2 EXACTLY: one square composed of EXACTLY SEVEN fitted tangram pieces, EXACTLY FIVE triangles (two large, one medium, two small), ONE small square, ONE parallelogram. Each piece a shallow painted wooden solid. COPY THE SEVEN-REGION SEAM LAYOUT in reference; add no eighth region or extra seam.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A looped fine tan cord carrying warm-yellow small spiral snail shells with darker openings and pale edge highlights. Preserve the icon's open necklace curve and eight visibly separate shells; no pendant, beads or extra symbols. CRITICAL: Match reference 3: EXACTLY EIGHT visible separate spiral snail shells on ONE thin tan open U-shaped cord. Count EIGHT. No ninth shell, no seventh-only necklace. All eight sit fully inside cell.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A thick golden-brown cake slice with a pale cream top and warm crumb-colored sides rests on a pale ceramic plate with a muted teal rim; one small golden coin is visible at the front of the slice. Preserve the cut slice and single coin, without icing words, dates or extra decorations. CRITICAL: Match reference 4: ONLY ONE THICK TRIANGULAR CAKE SLICE on plate, not a whole round cake. Pale top and warm brown crumb. ONE small SOLID ROUND GOLD COIN at the front, absolutely NO HOLE, no characters. Keep single slice composition.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A brown branching pussy-willow twig with three soft ivory catkins and small coral and yellow paper decorations stands beside a pink wrapped chocolate egg in a shallow tan woven basket. Keep the twig, catkins, paper accents and wrapped egg distinct. CRITICAL: Match reference 5: EXACTLY THREE pussy-willow catkin heads on three twig tips, two paper diamond ornaments coral and yellow, one wrapped pink egg in shallow basket. No fourth catkin cluster.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: One irregular charcoal-black coal lump with a few blue-gray facets sits beside a small warm tan stone hearth with an amber flame and an open tan doorway. Preserve the single coal lump, low hearth and simple architectural framing, without extra gifts or figures. CRITICAL: Match reference 6's full group: one low small stone hearth and amber flame at left, one OPEN TALL TAN DOORWAY behind/right, and one irregular coal lump at its threshold. Include doorway. No human, closed door or extra gifts.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: A small tan sand pagoda rises in three tapering stepped tiers beside a slender bamboo pole with a top crossbar and one pale orange notched paper banner. Keep the sand texture, separate side pole and unlettered hanging paper; no added temple ornaments or script. CRITICAL: Match reference 7's stepped silhouette: EXACTLY THREE tapering sand stages, wide base, medium middle stage, pointed conical top counts as third. Separate bamboo pole on right and one blank pale-orange notched paper banner. No extra fourth sand tier.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: A simple brown wooden doorway with a sliding cross-barred panel stands behind a small square tan wooden bean box, with three golden roasted soybeans visible around its open top. Keep the wooden structure and loose beans, without masks, figures or added writing. CRITICAL: Match reference 8: an OPEN wooden doorway with cross-bar panel slid to the right, small square wooden bean box in front, EXACTLY THREE golden soybeans visible: one above box and two at its open top. No fourth bean, face mask or closed door.
9. Cell row 3, column 3: A red pomegranate with a small pointed crown is split open to show pale cream pith and ruby-red seeds above a low beige stone threshold, with one loose red seed beside it. Preserve the naturally broken fruit state and visible seeds, without a knife, bowl or decorative additions. CRITICAL: Match reference 9: ONE naturally cracked/broken red pomegranate, ragged opening showing cream pith and ruby seeds, small pointed crown, above a low pale stone THRESHOLD and one loose red seed. Keep threshold. No clean cut wedge, plate or knife.
